steps.content: In the depths of desolate WhiteSands, a few travelers are sitting inside Tuco's only shabby motel.
Beside the counter, the motel owner is personally attending to an out-of-town merchant. The man slams his empty beer mug on the table, his boastful voice echoing throughout the motel.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: I've been in the business for so many years. There's no treasure I haven't seen! I ain't bragging, but my eyes are sharper than those frigging instruments!

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Look at the antique I got this time. With just one glance, I knew it was genuine. That dumb bumpkin even thanked me for taking this junk off his hands. Haha!

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: He didn't even know he was being swindled. That's why he's poor!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Wow, that was really impressive! Let me get you a refill on the house—it's my honor.
Mira refills the merchant's empty mug. Leaning on the table with her elbow, she lowers her torso with a gaze of admiration and awe.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: The moment you walked in, I felt your aura was different from the other guests. What a worldly gentleman!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Not like me. All my life, I've never known what an antique looked like...

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: That's easy! Since you're interested, I'll show you.
Drunk on flattery and beer, the merchant waves his hand and eagerly opens the bag containing the antique ceramic jar.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: So this is an antique... I might not have the right words for it, but it looks rare and valuable. Oh, only an expert like you deserves to have something so exquisite!

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Of course! Do you know who I am? Let me tell you, this antique is so special because...

steps.speaker: Drunkard
steps.content: Hey, you! Yeah, you!
Suddenly, a drunkard appears out of nowhere, forcefully grabbing the merchant's collar, cutting off his unfinished boasts.

steps.speaker: Drunkard
steps.content: You have the audacity to come back, you ungrateful wretch? After you, hic, gambled away my life's savings? How did I end up with a son like you... (Cries loudly)

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: What the heck? Who the hell are you? How dare you call yourself my dad?!
The two men push and shove each other, toppling a chair and crashing into the counter. Mira quickly moves the mugs and bag to the side, anxiously waving her hands.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: There must be some misunderstanding! Please stop fighting! It won't be good if you damage anything here.
But the two men, tangled in their brawl, completely ignore Mira. Amidst the chaos, the motel's wooden door is forcefully pushed open from the outside.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: What's going on! Who gave you the right to fight in the motel? Stop it, both of you!

steps.speaker: Drunkard
steps.content: Oh, the injustice! A son not recognizing his father! I'll report this to the police! I must... report this!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: How can a twenty-year-old be a father to a forty-year-old... Are you two causing trouble? Come with me down to the station. Save your words for then.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Wait, wait a minute, my antique is still in there...

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: So on top of fighting, you also want to obstruct justice? You better behave if you don't want to land in jail!
This bizarre farce concludes with the sheriff taking the two men away. Meanwhile, in a corner of the motel, a figure stealthily approaches the counter without anyone noticing.
But before he can touch the antique, a gentle reminder rings in his ear.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Hey there, in my motel, no one touches other guests' belongings.
The thief shivers, turning to see that the speaker is a frail, unarmed young girl.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: If there's something troubling you, you can tell me, but you can't take someone else's things... ah!
Mira didn't get to finish her sentence. The thief suddenly tries to grab the bag she's protecting.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: Cut the crap! Hand it over!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Don't push... ah!
In the scuffle, the ceramic jar slips out of the half-open zipper and hurtles through the air in a graceful arc.
Crash!
Silence fills the room as the fragments scatter everywhere. The thief turns pale and tries to flee, but Mira reacts quicker.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: Eek?! What are you doing! Let go of me!
Mira smiles gently, effortlessly grabbing the thief by his collar. No matter how hard he struggles, the delicate hand that he easily swatted away earlier now has an iron grip on him.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: That's not going to work. If you leave, I won't be able to explain to the guest when he returns.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: What do you want, then! Don't expect me to take the blame alone! I have no money!

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: P-plus, you're also at fault for breaking the jar! If I'm going down, you're going down with me!
In the face of the thief's hostility, Mira sighs softly. Her face dims slightly from being misunderstood.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: You've misunderstood. I don't want to harm you. I want to help you.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: That merchant has many connections in DisCity. Breaking his jar will certainly make him hold a grudge against you. Even if you escape from me, he'll catch up with you later.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: If you run off now, you'll truly seal your own fate.
Her words make sense. The thief feels a bit shaken. While he still struggles vigorously, his strength is a lot weaker than before.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: ...Is that buffoon really a big shot? But I'll be dead if I stay here, too! Let me go!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Oh, don't worry. I have a plan.
Catching the hint behind Mira's words, the thief stops struggling and turns to question her.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: The sheriff will likely detain them for two days. We still have time. If we go to my acquaintance now, we should be able to make a passable replica of the jar.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: ...Wait, why are you being so nice? We don't know each other. Why are you helping me?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Perhaps... because I see my past in you. I once stole from others to survive, and did even worse things. So I somewhat understand your struggles.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Breaking the jar is partly my fault. Everyone makes mistakes. By helping you now, maybe someone will help me when I'm in trouble.
Yingying

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: So, think you can trust me?

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: ...As if I have other options! Lead the way.
Near the motel's back door, amidst the choking smoke, the thief stares at the stove and person in chef's clothes in silent shock.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: So you make counterfeits right under people's noses?! And... he's the "acquaintance" you mentioned???

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Cooking and pottery both involve fire. It's not that different. What are you staring at? Never seen a chef before? If you don't want me to do it, that's fine with me.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: No, no, that's not what I meant...

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: It's alright, he's an outsider who doesn't know the rules here. Don't be hard on him. We're here to see you because we really need your help.
After listening to the two explain their plan and describe the original appearance of the jar, the chef pats his chest and agrees.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: No problem. Twenty-five thousand DisCoins, and I'll make an identical one in five days.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: Five days? That's too long! Can you please hurry... we need it in two days.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Sure, the more money, the faster. Fifty thousand DisCoins for two days.

steps.speaker: Thief
steps.content: What the hell! You can't just double the price like that! This is highway robbery!

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Don't want to pay with DisCoins? If you can pay in Hypercubes, that's fine too.
Seeing the conflict about to escalate into a physical altercation, Mira quickly steps in to ease the tension.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Both of you, calm down. Let's talk about it nicely, okay?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: I also share some responsibility in this matter. How about we negotiate a price that works for both of you, and I'll cover half of it?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: I know making pottery is hard work, but fifty thousand is indeed a bit too expensive. Considering how long we've known each other, can you give us a discount? How about twenty thousand?

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: I can give you a discount, but with what you're asking for, I can't even break even. You should be fair, ma'am.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Then, can you do it for us half-price? Twenty-five thousand? Please.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: ...Tsk, alright. For you, I'll take this loss. Come pick it up tomorrow. Mira, you owe me one.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Hey kid. She bargained so hard for you. Don't tell me you can't even cough up half of twenty-five thousand.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Sorry, this is the lowest price I can get for us. Are you okay with it?
The thief reluctantly reaches into his pockets and gathers just enough money to cover his share.
After handing over the DisCoins to the pottery-making chef, Mira smiles gently at the worried thief.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Don't worry. There won't be any problems. With my help, you'll definitely get through this.
